frase_inicial: Timothy and Melanie: your spare cash, a high-rate card and little life cover are all competing for the same money.

tarjetas.frente: High-rate credit card is holding your score back
tarjetas.reverso: Carrying that card at a high interest rate costs you more than keeping the cash idle. Paying part from what you already have would remove the immediate drag and still leave a large cushion for emergencies.
tarjetas.detalle: Pay $6,800 from cash toward the 18% Chase card to lower the revolving balance; balance afterward would be $11,200.

tarjetas.frente: Life cover is thin while two kids depend on both incomes
tarjetas.reverso: If one earner died, the family would lose a large share of income and still face debt and future college costs. Adding straightforward term life cover for each of you closes that gap first for the children.
tarjetas.detalle: Add $235,000 life cover to reach $485,000 total (plan notes further increase to $491,800 after card paydown).

tarjetas.frente: You have much more cash than the emergency reserve needs
tarjetas.reverso: About a year of essentials sits in cash, well above the recommended cushion. That excess is a resource: it can be split to reduce expensive debt and to buy protection without risking day-to-day safety.
tarjetas.detalle: Accessible cash listed as $150,800; cash above reserve and short-term goals listed as $60,222.50.

tarjetas.frente: College for Liam and Josh is unfunded today
tarjetas.reverso: Nothing is set aside for college, so future payments will compete with other priorities. A small yearly saving plan would make the goal practical alongside debt paydown and insurance.
tarjetas.detalle: College funding gap shown as $113,508.60 total; extra first-year saving needed $4,609.22.

tarjetas.frente: No umbrella liability cover leaves your savings exposed
tarjetas.reverso: Home and car insurance exist, but a large liability claim could reach the savings you hold for the kids. A simple extra liability policy would shield those assets without touching your emergency cushion.
tarjetas.detalle: Plan shows no umbrella policy; recommended minimum $1,000,000 gap.
